title: REAL_TO_INT rounds an exact half to the even integer
note: IEC 61131-3, data type conversion: a REAL converts to the nearest integer and an exact half goes to the even one (IEC 60559 roundTiesToEven): 0.5 -> 0, 1.5 -> 2, 2.5 -> 2, 3.5 -> 4, -0.5 -> 0, -1.5 -> -2, -2.5 -> -2; the REAL just below one half (0.49999997) is 0; 8388607.5 (the last REAL with a fraction) goes to 8388608
